description: This file defines an abstract base class `BaseImageGenerationConfig` for configuring and handling image generation requests within a larger AI/ML framework. It includes method signatures for parameter handling, URL construction, environment validation, error handling, request transformation, and response processing, designed to be extended by subclasses for specific providers or models.

classes.name: BaseImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Abstract base class for image generation configuration, defining methods for parameter support, URL building, environment validation, error handling, request/response transformation, and form-data usage.
